raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+4' Referee Michael Salisbury signals NO PENALTY for Tottenham after a VAR review!

90+4' Surely that's handball by one of the West Ham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on! Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Tottenham! Let's see what he decides.
90+4' The free kick from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
90+3' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
90+2' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
90+1' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Yellow card. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
89' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
88' David Moyes has decided to substitute Mohammed Kudus and he is replaced by Pablo Fornals (West Ham).
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Heung-Min Son will be replaced by Alejo Veliz (Tottenham).
87' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
87' Flag up against Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
86' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned and punches the ball away.
85' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.
84' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) replacing Brennan Johnson.
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Bryan Gil (Tottenham) is replacing Yves Bissouma.
84' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
80' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
80' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
78' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a poor cross in from the free kick that is cleared by the head of a defender.
78' An attempted cross from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared.
77' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
74' 1 - 2 Goal! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:2.
74' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) hits the right post with a rebound from just outside the box.
74' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Lukasz Fabianski.
73' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
70' Richarlison (Tottenham) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
70' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
68' Lukasz Fabianski saves his team from danger as he rises high to pluck the ball out of the air from a free kick by Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
67' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso is replaced by Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
67' The referee signals a substitution. Richarlison (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg.
66' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Fabianski intercepts the ball.
63' Michael Salisbury has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
62' The linesman signals that Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
62' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
62' A lofted cross from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
61' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
59' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
57' Emerson (West Ham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
56' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Guglielmo Vicario to make a comfortable save.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:1.
50' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and it's Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
48' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
47' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
47' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' Emerson (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) prepares to take a corner kick.

45+2' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

45+1' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Lukasz Fabianski anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Mohammed Kudus plays a short lofted pass to Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
44' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
43' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
42' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle as Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

40' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
40' Now Tottenham have a corner.
40' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but Guglielmo Vicario punches the ball away.

37' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Lukasz Fabianski to get hold of the ball.
36' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
34' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
29' The linesman raises his flag. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.

26' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
25' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a smart save to deny him.
25' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
23' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' Ben Davies (Tottenham) commits a foul and Michael Salisbury immediately signals a free kick.
21' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) receives a pass from Brennan Johnson and attempts to score from the edge of the box, but the shot slips well wide of the right post.
20' There's an opportunity for James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
19' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
17' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Lukasz Fabianski easily deals with the threat.
15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
13' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

11' 1 - 0 The ball was swung into the box by Pedro Porro from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham), who planted a bullet header inside the left post to make the score 1:0.
11' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner.
11' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Tottenham win a corner.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
5' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Michael Salisbury had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
3' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
1' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
1' The first half has just begun.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury will referee today's match.
